# Alena Kuritka

> Portfolio of Alena Kuritka, graphic designer & illustrator; bilingual site (English default, Czech).

Graphic design, illustration and visual work across cultural and commercial contexts. Contact: alenakuritka@gmail.com, +420 721 011 680.

## Pages

- [Home](https://alena.kuritka.com/): Hero, selected work, about, contact
- [Portfolio](https://alena.kuritka.com/portfolio): All projects

## Projects

- [Scarlet Macaw](https://alena.kuritka.com/portfolio/ara): Brand identity
- [Avian](https://alena.kuritka.com/portfolio/bird): Illustration & merchandise
- [Feline](https://alena.kuritka.com/portfolio/cat): Illustration & merchandise
- [Hyacinth Macaw](https://alena.kuritka.com/portfolio/hyacinth): Pattern & product design
- [Narrative Works](https://alena.kuritka.com/portfolio/illustration): Editorial illustration
- [Paintings](https://alena.kuritka.com/portfolio/paintings): Fine art
- [Retail & Display](https://alena.kuritka.com/portfolio/pos): Commercial design
- [Lone Wolf](https://alena.kuritka.com/portfolio/wolf): Identity & merchandise
